styles.Ambitious: You aim high and go for it. Big goals make you shine.
styles.Determined: You keep going when things get hard. You finish what you start.
styles.Outgoing: You light up a room. Making friends is your thing.
styles.Creative: Your head is full of new ideas. You make things nobody else would.
styles.Enthusiastic: You bring the fun everywhere you go. Your energy is catching.
styles.Restless: You love trying new things. Every day can be an adventure.
styles.Highly Energetic: You are always on the move. Your body loves to go, go, go.
styles.Thinker: You can think about one hard thing for a long time. Not many people can.
styles.Playful: You turn anything into a game. You make people laugh.

powers.name: Focus
powers.line: You can stick with one hard thing for a long time.
powers.try_this: Pick one puzzle and finish it. No switching.

powers.name: Curiosity
powers.line: You always want to know how things work.
powers.try_this: Ask one big question at dinner tonight.

powers.name: Independence
powers.line: You like to figure things out on your own.
powers.try_this: Plan your own Saturday morning, start to finish.

powers.name: Imagination
powers.line: Your head is full of new ideas.
powers.try_this: Make up a new game and teach it to someone.

powers.name: Never Give Up
powers.line: When it gets hard, you keep going.
powers.try_this: Finish one thing you stopped halfway.

powers.name: Brave Voice
powers.line: You are learning to say what you think.
powers.try_this: Put your hand up once in class this week.
